chapter: Childhood, Mardi Gras and first brass band
title: First brass band: Tajama Garnier's Carnival Day band
summary: He played Carnival Day each year in Garnier's brass band with Henry Glass on drums, clarinet only and no saxophones.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Probably changed then. Probably changed then. We'll ask him some of these days. I'll see him. I haven't talked to him yet. I don't think he had a tape. What was the first brass band you ever played in?
First brass band I played in, I think that was... I used to play on Carnival Day. That was a band, just got a job on Carnival Day.
So did you pick up from the make up band?
That was for the Jefferson City Buzzer, we used to play every year. That was with Tajama Garnier. He was a trumpet player. That was with Tajama Garnier.
He just got whoever he could find for that day, was that an organized band or was it?
Yeah, he had a regular group that he used to manage to get the same fellas every year. You know every year? Yeah, Booker T was playing drum, glass.
There's a drummer with that name up in Chicago, came from Memphis, I wondered if he really was. Booker T Washington, I know his name was.
Yeah, Booker T was playing drum and... I just can't think of the guy's name.
Any of the trombones, remember any of the trombones or...
I can't remember who was playing trombones.
Did they have any saxophones in those bands in those days or... Just the clarinet?
